subject: Language A: literature

objectives.name: Explain what the texts and works mean, including their implications; connect your interpretation to their writing and reception contexts, the craft used and the features of their forms.
Judge how language and artistic choices shape meaning and effects; compare texts and examine the views they offer on human concerns.
Present your ideas so your reader or listener can follow and assess a persuasive argument; adapt your style and register to the purpose and situation.

components.name: Individual oral (SL)

criteria.name: Knowledge, understanding and interpretation
criteria.guidance: Show what the extracts mean and what they imply about your global issue — not what happens in them.

criteria.name: Analysis and evaluation
criteria.guidance: Explain how the author's choices build the global issue. Naming a device without its effect earns nothing.

criteria.name: Focus and organization
criteria.guidance: The global issue is the through-line, not a label. It should decide what you include and what you cut.

criteria.name: Language
criteria.guidance: Accurate, precise and appropriately formal. Delivery counts — a recited script reads as flat.

notes: 15 minutes: 10-minute presentation on two literary works connected by a global issue, then 5 minutes of teacher questions.
A global issue must be significant at scale, transnational, and visible in everyday local contexts.
Works used for the individual oral may NOT be reused for the HL essay or for paper 2.
Four criteria A-D at 10 marks each, total 40.
The three syllabus headings are areas of exploration shared by SL and HL, not a prescribed reading list; the briefs do not identify the works selected by a school.

Objectives 1–3 are paraphrased from matching 2021 IB briefs hosted independently by two schools. The communication bullet expressly limited to literature and performance is excluded because this record is a different course. The briefs give assessment-component percentages, not per-objective weights; objective weightings remain null.
